scope: Six constrained interfaces or scoped results; no unconditional scientific closure.

findings.implemented_boundary: CalibrationDeclaration validates syntax and declared root separation; readiness and empirical admission always false.
findings.remaining_evidence: Actual artifacts, units/covariance and authenticated calibration/holdout provenance needed only for verified-calibration capability.

findings.implemented_boundary: Expected counts support zero and unknown response distinctly; likelihood and exclusion APIs reject unsupported requests.
findings.remaining_evidence: Count/no-record/exposure/correlated-daughter laws and response data remain missing.

findings.implemented_boundary: Each SCM claim is mapped to a bounded subcheck or deferred/source-reported status; G21 has its exact supplied d2 derivation only.
findings.remaining_evidence: Missing density/instrument/marginal derivations, v0.3 sources and empirical support remain open.

findings.implemented_boundary: Potential-WKI/filament demotion, local chart/mean/boundary restrictions and continuous 1/8 benchmark retained. Six finite groups only.
findings.remaining_evidence: Publication citation verification, discrete modes, marginal sectors and unresolved R6 comparison remain open.

findings.implemented_boundary: Finite strong lumpability and instantaneous output constancy are separate diagnostics; no generic necessity theorem.
findings.remaining_evidence: A stronger output/reduction theorem requires exact assumptions and separate proof review.

findings.implemented_boundary: First-order rank returns nonlinear/global identifiability as not-assessed; singular injective and noninjective controls retained.
findings.remaining_evidence: Higher-order and global identifiability need separate analysis.
